# The Hydrangea House

> A private five-bedroom retreat inside the Auburn University Club in Auburn, Alabama — booked direct, no service fees.

The Hydrangea House (property nickname: Club Creek) is a creekside home ten minutes from Toomer's Corner and Jordan-Hare Stadium, available for game weekends, family stays, Camp War Eagle, Parents Weekend, and quiet weeks away.

## Contact

- Phone: (334) 797-1012
- Email: tdalton508@gmail.com
- Location: Auburn, Alabama 36832 (Auburn University Club community; street number not published)
